summary.text: Althea Stevens represents the 16th District on the New York City Council, which includes Morrisania, Highbridge, Concourse and parts of University Heights in the Bronx.
Her Council page lists her as chair of the Committee on Children and Youth.

paragraphs.text: Her Council biography describes her as a New York native and community advocate for the Bronx and a single teen mother.

It says she began her civic career more than 15 years ago at non-profit agencies and community centers, where she organized voting rights information sessions, led workshops on gang policing and created annual youth forums.
Besides chairing Children and Youth, she sits on the Committees on Cultural Affairs, Libraries and International Relations and on Governmental Operations, State and Federal Legislation.
